title: Role In Sight: 30d Onboard Playbook and Decision Slate
content:
Purpose: a compact, high-touch 30‑day activation and decision slate for mid-senior IC and manager hires that need cross-pod assimilation. This doc combines an intake-based hire plan, interview evidence / reviewer rubric summary, day 0–30 checklist, early-impact milestones, and a go/no-go decision template for the hiring manager + people partner. Use this as the canonical lightweight packet to reduce ambiguity on orientation expectations and early performance signals.

Quick context / why this exists:
- We see friction when offers land: inconsistent manager expectations, unclear cross-team handoffs, and late surprises at week 2 that could have been surfaced earlier.
- Aim: make first 30 days explicit, reduce cognitive load for managers, and create repeatable, evidence-led decision points.

Intake (to be completed pre-offer acceptance by hiring manager + people partner)
- Role summary (1–2 lines): owner to fill.
- Key success metrics (30d snapshot): 3 measurable outcomes (owner sets 1 primary + 2 supporting). Examples: "deploy a smoke test for X", "validate onboarding dataset quality with 2 data owners", "ship first small bug fix to production pipeline and observe no regressions".
- Cross-stakeholders & mentors: list names + slack handles.
- Access checklist primed (IT): VPN, repo, CI, calendar, gdrive folder, infra sandbox.
- Ramp priority level: Quiet Launch (low external exposure) | High-Impact (deliverable expected in 30d) — choose one.

Interview evidence: boiled-down rubric for offer handoff (summary for people partner)
- Technical competence: evidence present? (code sample, pairing session, system design notes) — short bullets captured from interviewers.
- Product sense / tradeoffs: quick example candidate gave.
- Collaboration & communication: examples from behavioral questions and panel feedback.
- Risk flags: any concern (infrastructure gaps, domain knowledge, culture fit) listed with severity (low/med/high).
- Confidence score (panel average, 1–5).

Early 30d milestones (owner fills with specific items tied to success metrics)
- Week 0 (day 0–3): admin & orientation
  - Complete IT / security onboarding (ticket #).
  - Intro 1:1s scheduled with 5 cross-stakeholders.
  - Shadow runbook onboarding: run the dev environment end-to-end. Notes: attach short checklist.
- Week 1 (day 4–10): immersion & small wins
  - Finish the small starter task (<= 1 day dev + review): description + PR link.
  - Present "first-week learnings" to manager (10–15 min).
  - Setup weekly 1:1 cadence + initial feedback loop.
- Week 2 (day 11–17): domain contributions
  - Support a real customer/incident triage or contribute to a release checklist.
  - Complete 30m knowledge transfer with primary mentor.
  - Begin drafting the 30d impact plan.
- Week 3 (day 18–24): independent delivery
  - Deliver first small scoped project or an actionable research doc.
  - Solicit feedback from 3 stakeholders using the short evidence form.
- Week 4 (day 25–30): decision prep & handoff
  - Finalize 30d impact review doc (template below).
  - Go/no-go decision meeting scheduled with manager + people partner + mentor.

Evaluation artifacts (what to collect)
- Starter PR or ticket link (low-friction validation).
- Short "evidence form" responses from 3 stakeholders (templated).
- Candidate self-reflection document (one page, 3 things learned, 3 blockers, 3 next steps).
- Manager observation notes (structured prompts).

Templatized evidence form (stakeholders) — single paragraph answers acceptable
1) What did the hire deliver or unblock?
2) Quality (score 1–5) + short justification.
3) Collaboration notes: how did they communicate?
4) Risk observations (if any).

Manager observation prompts (used to structure meeting + final decision)
- Ramp velocity: meeting attendance, onboarding tasks completed, first PR quality.
- Domain understanding: grasp of system architecture, dependencies identified.
- Team fit: examples of communication and cross-team work.
- Blockers and mitigation plan: what remains and how to reduce risk.
- Recommendation: continue, extend probation with specific plan, or offboarding (rare).

Go / No-Go decision checklist (script for 30d meeting)
- Present: manager, people partner, primary mentor, hiring manager (optional).
- Each artifact reviewed briefly: PR, evidence forms, candidate self-reflection.
- Check: Were the intake success metrics meaningfully advanced? (yes / partial / no).
- For any "partial" items, specify measurable remediation (owner, timeline).
- Decision options: Confirmed (move to standard onboarding), Extended ramp (explicit 30d extension + deliverables), Offboard (documented reasons + next steps).
- Capture decision in doc and notify people ops to process change in HRIS.

Communication templates (short snippets)
- Welcome email to team (manager): "Please welcome NAME joining as ROLE on DATE. They will own X. Primary mentor: NAME. Book a 15m intro if you’ll work with them closely."
- 30d decision invite (calendar): subject "30d Check: NAME — decision meeting" attendees manager/people partner/mentor. Attach evidence packet.

Microlearning schedule (first 30d) — recommended slots to reduce cognitive load
- Day 2: infra sandbox walkthrough (30m).
- Day 5: product roadmap 1:1 with PM (30m).
- Day 9: codebase orientation + readme deep-dive (45m).
- Day 14: security & compliance quick primer (30m).
- Day 21: release process & CI/CD demo (30m).

Notes-to-self / open questions (working list)
- How to standardize "starter task" complexity across roles? (Action: propose 3 templates by role family).
- Do managers need a quick rubric training session? (Action: add a 20m training in the manager onboarding playbook).
- Should people partner sign the decision slate by default? Current practice: often present, not always co-signer.

Appendix: templates (copy/paste)
- 30d impact review template (short):
  - Role & hire date:
  - Primary success metric (30d):
  - Evidence collected (links):
  - Stakeholder scores (avg) and key quotes:
  - Manager recommendation and rationale:
  - Final decision & next steps:

- Short stakeholder evidence prompt (one-line friendly):
  "Hi NAME — quick favor: can you reply to these 4 bullets about [NEW HIRE NAME] by EOD Friday? 1) What they shipped/blocked; 2) Quality (1–5); 3) Collaboration; 4) Any concerns? Thanks!"

Quick logistics & admin checklist (to be tracked in repo or our HRIS)
- Offer accepted: update access request form.
- Day 0: IT ticket closed.
- Day 7: starter PR merged or documented blocker.
- Day 14: mentor check-in note filed.
- Day 30: decision recorded.

Signals guide (what to watch for)
- Green: consistent delivery on starter tasks, good cross-team communication, asks clear questions.
- Yellow: slow progress due to missing context, needs pairing but shows learning velocity, needs explicit mentor pairing.
- Red: repeated missed milestones, poor communication, or significant technical mismatch — escalate early.

How to use this doc (next steps)
- People partner: ensure intake completed pre-offer, schedule 30d decision meeting in week 4.
- Manager: fill milestones + starter task before offer acceptance.
- Mentor: own week 1 walkthrough and day 14 check-in.

Version history / notes
- v0.1 2025-08-04 Priya initial draft (intake + milestones)
- v0.2 2025-08-10 Ethan added evidence form + decision script
- v0.3 2025-08-12 Maya added microlearning schedule + templates

End of doc — comments welcome.

(Notes: informal — this is a working packet meant to live in Drive and be copied into the candidate’s onboarding folder. Keep it lightweight; avoid bureaucratic duplication with the larger manager onboarding playbook.)
